title: Evaluating Sakana’s AI Scientist for Autonomous Research: Wishful Thinking or an Emerging Reality Towards ‘Artificial Research Intelligence’ (ARI)?

bias_targets.methodology: Testing the AI Scientist's peer-review agent on 10 human-written papers from OpenReview.net (5 previously accepted, 5 previously rejected) and comparing its accept/reject recommendations against actual human judgments to evaluate its baseline stringency.
